in_marathi.name: Satyabrata
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyabrata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satyabrata is a Sanskrit name for a boy which is derived from two words 'Satya' meaning truth and 'Brata' meaning pledge or vow. This name signifies one who is truthful and honest in his actions and words.
